sourceTitle: Chicken With A Raspberry Champagne Glaze
sourceText:
Chicken With A Raspberry Champagne Glaze
By: Jennifer
Published: Tuesday, May 15, 2012 - 7:53pm

Ingredients




Glaze
1 C fresh raspberries
2 Tbsp. honey
1 tsp. raspberry vinegar
3 boneless chicken thighs
salt and pepper
2 Tbsp olive oil

Preparation

1 Add raspberries, honey, and vinegar into a small saucepan. 2 Bring to a boil. 3 Turn heat down to medium low and simmer until it thickens, approximately 20 to 30 minutes. Keep warm. 4 When you get ready to baste your chicken pour out about ¾ of the glaze and keep the rest warm to baste onto the meat right before serving. 5 Salt and pepper both sides of chicken. 6 Heat a skillet over medium high heat. 7 Heat oil. 8 Brown chicken on both sides. 9 Heat oven to 375 degrees. 10 Brush glaze over meat 11 Bake 15 minutes 12 Baste chicken again with glaze. 13 Bake for approximately another 10 to 15 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink and registers 165 degrees with a meat thermometer. 14 Brush with glaze before serving. 15 This goes great with rice and brussel sprouts, broccoli, asparagus, peas, or whatever your favorite vegetable side is!

About

Here’s an idea for taking fresh raspberries beyond the yogurt and cereal bowl and into cocktail hour and even the main course!
Not only is this chicken dish sweet, flavorful, and healthy…it also makes a colorful presentation! The mint and honey balance the tangy raspberries and bubbly in the cocktail and the fruity glaze compliments the rich dark meat.
